scope: Architecture contract only. No nonlinear-core implementation, formulation change, maturity change or WP02 work is authorized by this record.

canonical_equations.residual: R(u, lambda, state) = lambda * F_ext - F_internal - F_contact
canonical_equations.residual_sign: Positive residual is the unapplied external force. Existing internal-minus-external implementation conventions may be adapted internally for diagnostics only; physical force definitions are not changed to normalize signs.
canonical_equations.reaction_sign: Reactions are recovered from the physical equilibrium residual on constrained DOFs. A positive reported reaction is the force exerted by the constrained system on the model, and the external-plus-reaction resultant must satisfy the declared equilibrium convention.
canonical_equations.free_fixed_dofs: Global Newton corrections and residual convergence are evaluated on free DOFs. Fixed DOFs are prescribed inputs, excluded from correction solves, and included only in physical reaction/equilibrium recovery.
canonical_equations.load_factor_ownership: The authoritative driver owns lambda, its predictor/update and accepted value. Contributions receive lambda as immutable evaluation input and must not advance it.
canonical_equations.contribution_accumulation: Contributions add internal force and tangent terms to one composite response. The driver alone forms lambda*F_ext minus the accumulated internal/contact terms.

semantics: begin_trial creates a detached trial view from one accepted committed state.
Contribution evaluation may update only trial-owned state returned through the common response.
commit atomically replaces the full committed state after global increment acceptance.
rollback discards trial state and leaves every committed component unchanged.
A stateful contact contribution must declare its state payload even when a current formulation is stateless.

deterministic_digest.encoding: Canonical deterministic serialization with explicit schema/version and stable ordering; array dtype, shape and bytes must be represented.
deterministic_digest.rollback_gate: Committed-state component digests and composite digest must be exactly identical before begin_trial and after rejected increment rollback.

accepted_increment_transaction.boundary: One authoritative driver transaction spans displacement, material history, contact history and continuation variables.
lifecycle: global convergence and subsystem admissibility evaluation
commit full increment atomically on PASS
rollback full increment, then cut back/retry only if policy allows, on FAIL
accepted_increment_transaction.commit_failure: Commit is staged and validated before publication. If any component validation/copy/persistence preparation fails, the driver reports STATE_CORRUPTION or CHECKPOINT_FAILURE as applicable, publishes no partial committed state, restores the pre-commit digest and treats the increment as failed.
prohibited: material-level accepted-state mutation before driver acceptance
silent fallback to another global solver

contribution_contract.primary_seam: Retain NonlinearAssemblyProtocol and CompositeNonlinearAssembly; evolve only if a demonstrated contract gap requires a backward-compatible extension.
contribution_contract.driver_knowledge: The common driver is formulation-neutral and does not interpret constitutive laws, contact geometry or friction physics.

families.MaterialContribution: Provides constitutive internal force/tangent and detached material trial state.
families.GeometricContribution: Provides geometric force/tangent and any declared kinematic trial metadata.
families.ContactContribution: Provides contact force/tangent, optional contact trial state and contact admissibility diagnostics.

contribution_contract.stateless_policy: Stateless contributions need not allocate a state payload and must remain inexpensive.
contribution_contract.stateful_policy: Stateful contributions return trial updates through the transaction boundary and may not commit them independently.

driver_ownership.prohibition: A contribution must not own an independent global Newton lifecycle. Legacy loops can survive only behind adapters or as declared research compatibility until migrated.

convergence_contract.subsystem_admissibility: Contact penetration, active-set consistency, material admissibility and arc-length constraint are contribution/continuation diagnostics. They may veto global acceptance but do not redefine unrelated material-only convergence norms.
convergence_contract.normalization: The driver records absolute and relative quantities with frozen denominators in diagnostics; no subsystem silently selects a different global convergence scale.
convergence_contract.diagnostics: Iteration history records global quantities plus namespaced contribution diagnostics and one deterministic terminal reason.

failure_retry_contract.policy: The existing enum is retained. No duplicate failure reason with equivalent meaning is introduced. Contributions may recommend a retry class; only the driver applies retry/cutback policy.

restart_requirements: reject incomplete state rather than reconstructing it heuristically
future_checkpoint_contract.implementation_boundary: WP01-A defines this future payload only; persistence changes are not authorized here.

compatibility_policy.public_api: No public API removal in WP01-A.
deprecate_later: legacy contact solver as a public global-driver alternative
research_boundaries: total_lagrangian_j2 remains formulation-neutral research pending OD-029-01
frictional active-set/Coulomb remains research compatibility until a common-driver adapter is qualified
mixed distributed nonlinear mechanics remains out of scope
compatibility_policy.diagnostic_mapping: Legacy diagnostics are mapped into common absolute residual, relative residual, correction norm, terminal reason and namespaced subsystem diagnostics without erasing legacy fields during compatibility support.

prospective_gates.gate: Only one authoritative global Newton lifecycle.
prospective_gates.threshold: 0 alternate public/global driver lifecycles after migration; compatibility adapters delegate to the authoritative driver.

prospective_gates.gate: Material, geometric and contact contributions coexist through one composition contract.
prospective_gates.threshold: 4 declared composition fixtures pass: material-only, geometric-only, penalty-contact-only, and combined material/geometric/contact.
Composite and component committed-state digests exactly equal pre-trial values after every injected rejection/failure fixture.

prospective_gates.gate: No contribution silently commits global state.
prospective_gates.threshold: 0 contribution-level commit events observed by transaction instrumentation outside driver-approved acceptance.
Frozen existing J2 references retain their declared tolerances; additionally displacement, reaction and energy relative error <= 1e-9 with absolute floor 1e-12, with no tolerance loosening.
Frozen existing geometric references retain their declared tolerances; additionally declared displacement, reaction and energy observables have relative error <= 1e-9 with absolute floor 1e-12.
Frozen penalty-contact references retain their declared tolerances; additionally declared displacement, reaction and penetration observables have relative error <= 1e-9 with absolute floor 1e-12.

prospective_gates.gate: Failures and diagnostics are explicit and deterministic.
prospective_gates.threshold: 2 identical replays per failure fixture produce identical terminal reason, retry class and deterministic diagnostics digest.
0 changes to existing maturity registry records or public maturity claims.

prospective_gates.gate: Compatibility adapters do not create a second authoritative driver.
prospective_gates.threshold: 0 adapter-owned global Newton loops; adapter trace identifies exactly one authoritative lifecycle.
